name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: A focused modal surface with a named header, dynamic content, optional actions, keyboard dismissal and focus restoration.
example:
<Dialog
  isOpen={open}
  onOpenChange={setOpen}
  title="Edit project"
  description="Keep the essential details together."
  footer={({ close }) => <Button onClick={close}>Done</Button>}
>
  <Input label="Project name" defaultValue="Studio launch" />
</Dialog>
